conversation_summary: Hugh and Stevens discussed a no-menu restaurant in Hanoi. Hugh said he eats all Vietnamese food and is confident (vững vàng) enough to try it, but admitted he doesn't like giò heo (pork knuckle) and would be cáu kỉnh if served it. He reflected on his tâm lý in that situation and concluded he prefers normal restaurants where he can choose his own dishes.
correction_notes: 'thêm đó' should be 'hơn nữa' or 'ngoài ra' (moreover/besides that)
'những món ăn mà tôi phải ăn' should be 'những món ăn mà tôi muốn ăn' — phải means have to, not want to
